_comment: Reference data - READ ONLY, never merged into data.json. Graph structure (what makes what) is exact vanilla behaviour and stable across versions. DURATIONS SHIFT BETWEEN RELEASES: verify against minecraft.wiki for the exact game version in World.gameVersion, then set verified:true. See docs/08-REFERENCE-DATA.md.
source: minecraft.wiki, hand-entered 2026-08-14. Durations verified against the installed game version 2026-08-15.

bases.name: Water Bottle
bases.from: Glass bottle filled at any water source or cauldron

bases.name: Awkward Potion
bases.ingredientSource: Nether fortress soul sand gardens; farmable on soul sand anywhere
bases.notes: The base for nearly every useful potion. Always brew a stack first.

bases.name: Mundane Potion
bases.ingredient: Redstone Dust, Sugar, Spider Eye, Magma Cream, Blaze Powder, Glistering Melon Slice, or Ghast Tear
bases.notes: No effect. A dead end - you brewed an ingredient into water instead of into Awkward.

entries.name: Potion of Fire Resistance
entries.ingredientSource: Blaze powder + slimeball, or magma cube drops in the nether
entries.notes: Essential for the nether. Brew before any bastion or fortress run. No level II exists.

entries.name: Potion of Swiftness
entries.notes: Cheapest useful potion - sugar cane is free and renewable.

entries.name: Potion of Slowness
entries.ingredient: Fermented Spider Eye (applied to Swiftness or Leaping)
entries.notes: Only useful as a splash potion thrown at mobs.

entries.name: Potion of Strength
entries.ingredientSource: Blaze rods from a nether fortress - you have one recorded
entries.notes: Adds flat melee damage. Stacks with Sharpness.

entries.name: Potion of Healing
entries.notes: Instant - Redstone Dust does nothing. Splash version heals allies; harms undead.

entries.name: Potion of Harming
entries.ingredient: Fermented Spider Eye (applied to Healing or Poison)
entries.notes: Instant. Heals undead mobs instead of damaging them.

entries.name: Potion of Leaping
entries.notes: Also reduces fall damage by the jump-boost level.

entries.name: Potion of Poison
entries.ingredientSource: Spiders - you have a spider spawner recorded
entries.notes: Never kills - drops the target to half a heart at most.

entries.name: Potion of Regeneration
entries.notes: Ghast tears are the bottleneck - kill ghasts over solid ground or the tear despawns in lava.

entries.name: Potion of Water Breathing
entries.notes: Essential for the ocean monument near your 823 / -271 shipwreck. No level II.

entries.name: Potion of Night Vision
entries.notes: Pairs with Water Breathing for monument runs. No level II.

entries.name: Potion of Invisibility
entries.ingredient: Fermented Spider Eye (applied to Night Vision)
entries.notes: Worn armour and held items stay visible. Remove armour for true invisibility. No level II.

entries.name: Potion of Weakness
entries.notes: The only useful potion brewed directly from water. Splash Weakness + golden apple cures zombie villagers.

entries.name: Potion of Slow Falling
entries.ingredientSource: Phantoms - spawn after 3 in-game days without sleeping
entries.notes: Negates all fall damage. Carry one on any nether ceiling trip. No level II.

entries.name: Potion of the Turtle Master
entries.ingredientSource: 5 scutes from baby turtles growing up
entries.notes: Massive damage reduction at the cost of near-immobility. Emergency button, not a buff.

entries.name: Potion of Wind Charging
entries.ingredientSource: Breeze in a trial chamber - YOU HAVE ONE RECORDED at 2217 / -5 / -4024
entries.notes: 1.21 addition. Emits a wind burst when the affected entity is damaged. VERIFY duration and whether extended/amplified variants exist in your version.

entries.name: Potion of Weaving
entries.ingredientSource: Spider spawner area - YOU HAVE ONE RECORDED at 91 / -13 / 200
entries.notes: 1.21 addition. Spreads cobwebs when the affected entity dies. VERIFY variants.

entries.name: Potion of Oozing
entries.ingredientSource: 9 slimeballs - slime chunks or swamp slimes
entries.notes: 1.21 addition. Spawns two slimes on the affected entity's death. VERIFY variants.

entries.name: Potion of Infestation
entries.notes: 1.21 addition. Chance to spawn silverfish when the affected entity takes damage. VERIFY variants.

modifiers.name: Redstone Dust
modifiers.doesNotWorkOn: Healing, Harming (instant), and the 1.21 effect potions
modifiers.notes: Apply BEFORE Gunpowder. Same result either way, fewer wasted ingredients.

modifiers.name: Glowstone Dust
modifiers.effect: Increases to level II, usually shortening duration
modifiers.appliesTo: Potions that have a level II
modifiers.doesNotWorkOn: Fire Resistance, Night Vision, Invisibility, Water Breathing, Slow Falling, Weakness, and the 1.21 effect potions
modifiers.notes: Mutually exclusive with Redstone Dust - a potion is extended OR amplified, never both.

modifiers.name: Gunpowder
modifiers.notes: Splash potions apply about 3/4 of the base duration to others. Apply last, after Redstone or Glowstone.

modifiers.name: Dragon's Breath
modifiers.effect: Converts a Splash potion to Lingering (leaves an area cloud)
modifiers.doesNotWorkOn: Regular potions - must be splashed first
modifiers.notes: Lingering clouds apply about 1/4 of the base duration. Collected from the ender dragon's breath attack with an empty bottle.

modifiers.name: Fermented Spider Eye
modifiers.effect: Corrupts a potion into its counterpart
modifiers.notes: Crafted from spider eye + brown mushroom + sugar.
